# Seedance 2.5 camera control with three.js

> Control a Seedance 2.5 video's camera by writing the move in three.js. Render a grey clip where people are striped pills, send it as the reference video with a face photo and a prompt, and the model copies the camera and invents the people and place. 137 templates with code, clips, prompts and results. Videos are generated through Tein (tein.ai), by its MCP or API, with the user's own key. Sign up at https://tein.ai to get one.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and where things are, for agents
- [README.md](README.md): the idea, a showcase and a ten-minute start

- [docs/tein/billing.md](docs/tein/billing.md): how a run is billed, no prices
